recordingPolicy.offlineStoreGuide: Offline: store WAV/chunks first (no live ASR); later batch transcribe → L0/L1 minutes
recordingPolicy.onlineLiveGuide: Online: live partial transcript while recording; audio still stored as backup; stop → minutes
recordingPolicy.shortCaptureGuide: Short: device flash cache (≤60s) → Sync/pull → host ASR → minutes
